# Malabar Trails — Slow Travel in God’s Own Country

> Artisanal slow travel, curated heritage stays, and private chauffeur fleet charters across Fort Kochi, Alleppey backwaters, and the Western Ghats in Kerala, India.

## Brand Overview
- **Company Name**: Malabar Trails Travel Co.
- **Established**: 2016
- **Accreditation**: Kerala Tourism Accr. #KT-4412
- **Studio Location**: 14/282 Bastian Street, Near Parade Ground, Fort Kochi, Cochin, Kerala 682001, India
- **Telephone**: +91 (0) 484 221 8904
- **Direct Mobile / WhatsApp**: +91 94470 12345
- **Inquiries**: journeys@malabartrails.com / namaste@malabartrails.com
- **Operating Hours**: Mon – Sat, 8:30 AM to 7:00 PM IST

## Core Philosophy (The Malabar Philosophy)
1. **Zero Tourist Traps**: No forced souvenir warehouses or rushed checkpoint itineraries. Only authentic village encounters and preserved heritage properties.
2. **Artisans & Elders**: Direct partnerships with seventh-generation spice farmers, traditional toddy tappers, coir weavers, and Kathakali performers with ethical and transparent honorariums.
3. **Quiet Chauffeurs**: Seasoned local storytellers, certified naturalists, and polite English & Malayalam-speaking navigators who honor privacy and unhurried travel tempo.

## Handpicked Journeys (Curated Itineraries)
- **Backwater Soul & Canoe Silence** (Alleppey & Vembanad | 4 Days / 3 Nights | Solar Kettuvallam | From ₹38,000 / couple): Glide through secret lagoons in Champakulam and stay in a handcrafted, solar-powered traditional wooden kettuvallam with a private chef.
- **Fort Kochi Heritage & Spice Trail** (Fort Kochi & Mattancherry | 3 Days / 2 Nights | Colonial Bungalow | From ₹24,500 / couple): Wander colonial alleys under ancient rain trees, explore historic spice godowns of Jew Town, and dine in preserved private ancestral courtyards.
- **Munnar Mist & Organic Tea Sanctuary** (Western Ghats & Munnar | 4 Days / 3 Nights | 5,000 Ft Homestay | From ₹32,000 / couple): Traverse single-track mountain paths, stay in artisan plantation bungalows, pluck heirloom tea leaves, and search for endemic Sholakili birdlife.
- **Custom Tailored Routes**: Customized journeys from 3 to 21 days across Wayanad, Bekal, Thekkady, and Marari Beach.

## Private Fleet & Chauffeur Charters
- **Class 01 — Local Explorers: Classic 350 & Vespa** (Solo / 2 Travelers • Fort Kochi & Coastal Alleys • Daily & Weekly Hire)
- **Class 02 — Refined Sedans: Etios & City** (Up to 3 Guests + Luggage • Transfers & Day Excursions • Fixed & Chauffeur Rates)
- **Class 03 — Premium Hill SUVs: Innova Crysta & Hycross** (4 to 6 Guests • Western Ghats & Family Journeys • Most Popular for Itineraries)
- **Class 04 — High-End 4x4: Defender & Fortuner** (Up to 5 Guests • Tea Estates & Wildlife Reserves • Bespoke Expeditions)
- **Class 05 — Kerala Glamping Caravans** (2 to 4 Guests • Mobile Backwater Sanctuary • Self-Sustaining Living)
- **Class 06 — Executive Urbania & Sprinter** (10 to 18 Guests • Retreats & Multi-Gen Families • Group Charters)

## Fleet Inclusions & Standards
- Fresh Tender Coconut & glass water bottles in every vehicle (plastic-free provisions).
- All-inclusive upfront pricing (fuel, state permits, parking, tolls, and driver allowance included).
- Polite English & Malayalam-speaking local drivers.
- Daily deep detailing scented with organic lemongrass.
